compute.scope: Actual unique text embeddings across the cohort plus ranking. Do not multiply shared batch/index costs by question or policy count.

dev.source_annotation_scope: Conditional source-contract outcomes under recorded source/response interpretations. Correct Reader abstention on a deficient selected subset is not task success when a source-supported answer exists in the full pool. Masked cases and qualified responses are retained separately. Native metrics and first outputs are unchanged; not universal or independent-gold accuracy.

scope: Decomposition size is an existing dataset stratum, not controlled difficulty or minimal proof length. Families and source dispositions retain separate denominators. No stratum with no cases is assigned zero accuracy. Qualified grounded answers remain described separately; unqualified-pass complements are not error counts. Source judgments are development-assistant review, not independent adjudicated gold.

plot_compute.scope: Wall time includes plotting subprocess. Coordinator CPU excludes subprocess CPU; not claimed as total CPU.
